This exact all-polynomial classification (including signed-coefficient cases positive on the natural domain) identifies the sole admissible fixed offset and unavoidable factor of X; it proves that the quadratic divisor in the specific successful construction is optimal throughout a natural polynomial template. This sharp resource obstruction and complete family description are more than a single parameter experiment, but no optimality beyond this template is claimed.
